name: @openagt/skill-github
description: GitHub as a skill for coding agents: the project's pull requests and issues through gh, and the one command OpenAgent and the scheduler run for the git host: requests, open, merge, home, and replies, what came on the pull requests this machine's agents opened since each ended.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
